statement: XGBoost relies more on self-rated health (A2) than on depressed mood (D2).
label: met (exploratory)
report: XGBoost relies more on self-rated health (A2) than on depressed mood (D2). Met (exploratory): on average, self-rated health (A2) 0.0463 versus depressed mood (D2) 0.0358 (difference 0.0105 [0.0016, 0.0195]); self-rated health (A2) exceeds depressed mood (D2) in 9 of 10 folds; 1 other is within Monte Carlo error or below the smallest relevant difference. The claim was formulated after the explanation was inspected; it is established only after a test on new data (csdg_confirm()).
